description: Fuzzy text search across route names, descriptions, and category labels. Resolves natural-language queries like "electricity retail sales by state" or "natural gas imports" to matching route paths. Multi-term queries are also matched term by term, so combining a commodity, a metric, and a sector — "electricity price residential", "coal generation industrial sector" — reaches the route carrying that data even when no single entry reads like the whole phrase. A query spelling the end of a route path in words — "retail sales" for electricity/retail-sales — ranks that route first. STEO and SEDS series names are indexed so queries like "crude oil production forecast" or "motor gasoline total consumption" also resolve, and so are facet values, so a fuel type or sector term like "wind" or "anthracite coal" resolves to the route that exposes it, with filter_hint carrying the filter to pass on. That includes the series and product names of the daily and weekly petroleum and natural-gas routes and the RTO balancing authorities, so benchmarks like "Henry Hub", "WTI crude spot price", "Cushing", or "Electric Reliability Council of Texas" resolve before any describe. A legacy APIv1 series ID as the EIA website and Excel add-in write them — "PET.RWTC.W", "ELEC.PRICE.TX-RES.M" — is resolved through the EIA series lookup into one result with its route, filter_hint, frequency, and columns, ready for eia_query_route, without waiting on the index. Results include isLeaf so you know whether to browse further or query directly. Results with score > 0.72 are weak matches — try a more specific query or use eia_browse_routes to explore the taxonomy. The first call after server start waits 20-40s while the index warms, and at most 45s; later calls answer from the built index. Check indexComplete before reading anything into a short or empty result set.

limit.description: Maximum results to return (default 10). One call returns at most 30; a larger limit is served at 30, and truncated says whether more matches exist.

query.description: Free-text search terms to match against route names and descriptions, or a legacy APIv1 series ID (e.g. "PET.RWTC.W": three or more dot-separated segments ending in a frequency code A, Q, M, W, D, H, HL, or 4; any case). Leading and trailing whitespace is ignored, and only the first 256 characters are searched.

name: eia_search_routes

cap.description: Most results this call could return — limit, or 30 when limit was larger.

effectiveQuery.description: Query as searched — the submitted text with surrounding whitespace trimmed, cut to its first 256 characters.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_invalid_response`: EIA returned an unusable response body or a missing route or data envelope. `upstream_unavailable`: EIA answered with a retryable HTTP service failure. `upstream_timeout`: EIA did not answer in time while the first call after server start built the route tree. An index pass that times out does not fail the search; it is reported in indexGaps. `rate_limited`: EIA rate limit hit (OVER_RATE_LIMIT) while building the route tree on the first call after server start. `upstream_unreachable`: EIA could not be reached (connection refused or reset, DNS failure) while building the route tree on the first call after server start. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

indexComplete.description: True when this answer was ranked against the complete warm-time corpus. False means part of it is missing (see indexGaps) — results may be short, and a better match may exist that was never scored. Facet values folded in by eia_describe_route are additional and never count toward completeness. A resolved series ID is answered by EIA, not ranked, so it does not depend on this.

indexGaps.description: Present only when indexComplete is false: route paths whose metadata could not be fetched (call eia_browse_routes on one to re-fetch it) and index passes that did not land ("steo_series", "seds_series", "facet_values"), which the next search retries.

notice.description: Discloses requested/effective limits when clamped and says when only the start of the query was searched; names a resolved series ID (saying so when EIA reports no rows for it), or says the lookup of a query shaped like one found nothing or failed (the results are then the text search); and gives guidance when no routes matched or more matches exist.

columns.description: Data column IDs the series reads (e.g. ["price"]). Present only on a resolved series ID; pass as eia_query_route columns.

filter_hint.description: Pre-built filter for eia_query_route when a specific facet value is required. Present on STEO and SEDS series results and facet-value results — fuel, sector, and RTO respondent values, and the series and product values of daily and weekly petroleum and natural-gas routes (e.g. {"series": "RNGWHHD"} on natural-gas/pri/fut) — and on a resolved series ID, where it holds every facet EIA maps the ID to, values as EIA writes them (e.g. {"sectorid": "RES", "stateid": "TX"}). Pass directly as filters (e.g. eia_query_route(route="seds", filters=filter_hint)).

frequency.description: Frequency ID the series is published at (e.g. "weekly", "local-hourly"). Present only on a resolved series ID; pass as eia_query_route frequency.

isLeaf.description: True when the route is a queryable leaf; false when it has sub-routes to browse.

route.description: Route path — usable directly in eia_describe_route or eia_query_route.

score.description: Match score: 0 = exact, 1 = no match. Lower is better; above 0.72 the match is unreliable. On a multi-term query it is the better of the whole-phrase score and a per-term score that penalizes each query term the entry does not carry. A resolved series ID scores 0.

totalIndexed.description: Total entries in the search index: routes, STEO and SEDS series names, and the facet values indexed at warm time, plus the facet values of every route described since the server started — so the count grows with describe calls.

truncated.description: True when more matches exist past the ones returned; false when these are all.

title: Search EIA Routes
